note: Long guard hash (S6a): `npm run test:long` runs src/headless/hash.ts for each seed below at `ticks` ticks with `params`, in parallel, and fails if any hash differs. `params` switches on every optional mechanism that is off by default and can run with the others, so a change to code that the default world never reaches still moves a hash. `npm run test:long -- --record` rewrites `seeds` from a fresh run. Re-record only when a change is meant to move one of these mechanisms, and say so in the commit.

why.loneIndividual: wolves judge a target's isolation by its own herd-mates, not the grid-cell crowd
why.matingWindow: yearly birth pulse for grazers (0.8 seasons, the screened value)
why.herdNearest: grazers keep near the nearest herd-mate instead of the herd centre (6 m, the screened value)
why.drinkSpots: only 70% of the shore is a drinking place (screened 0.6 to 0.8)
why.shoreSpread: staggered bison thirst and the walk back off the bank
why.shoreOpen: the walk back off the bank weakens in cover (only acts with shoreSpread)
why.herdBands: bison live in bands with split and merge checks
why.bandRoam: bands move on when their grass runs low (only acts with herdBands)
why.climateAmp: the old slow climate cycle on grass growth, stacked on climate2
why.droughtRefuge: riparian ground escapes part of a drought (0.7, the screened value)
why.sprintCost: global sprint cost for species without their own (evolution2 sets bison, pronghorn, wolf, coyote)
why.cougarImmigration: closed-valley cougar pairs while fewer than two live here
why.wolfImmigration: closed-valley wolf immigration while fewer than six live here
why.fleeMomentum: a re-scared grazer keeps part of its flight line
why.dogClip: prairie dog towns clip the grass short
why.dogGrazeBonus: bison prefer the edges of towns
why.beaver.initial: two founding colonies of four so the beaver code runs from tick 0, not only after a chance arrival
why.greenUpShift: spring green-up half a season late
why.feedBoutLeave: the pack leaves a kill at 40% of its meat
why.steerFreeUrgent: free steering in chases and flights only
why.huntNeedsScent: a pack must have scent before it hunts

excluded.shoreWaves: an alternative to shoreSpread (staggered thirst without the walk-off) that is ignored wherever shoreSpread is larger, so with shoreSpread on it does nothing
excluded.steerFree: free steering for every animal: a superset of steerFreeUrgent that makes it dead code, and the legacy pre-v2 steering
excluded.wolfArrivalTick: a start condition, not a mechanism: it removes the founding wolves and adds them back later (a recolonization scenario)
excluded.wolfBreedStore, coyoteCarrionShare: 0 is a working value of a threshold or share, not an off switch
excluded.calendarScale: the calendar, not a mechanism; the default 2 is kept
